title: Escrow
fundDialogBody: Project fees are paid directly between the parties. Simulated funding here does not hold real funds on the platform.
disputeDialogBody: Describe the issue clearly. Funds will be frozen until admin review.
escrowHistorySubtitle: Libyan Freelance does not receive or hold project funds. Payment is arranged directly between client and freelancer. Electronic payments on the platform are for subscriptions and points only.
noTransactions: No platform-held project payments — project fees are paid directly between the parties.
directPaymentBanner: Libyan Freelance is an advertising platform and technical intermediary connecting clients with freelancers. The platform does not receive project payment amounts, does not hold parties' funds, and does not guarantee project delivery or payment. Agreement and payment are made directly between the client and the freelancer.
platformPaymentsOnly: Electronic payments inside Libyan Freelance are only for subscriptions, points purchases, and digital services offered by the platform.
